invariants.rationale: Method returns a non-null Iterator as its main output.
instantTime is required to identify the timeline instant and is used in IOUtils.runMerge.
fileId uniquely identifies a file to update and is passed throughout.
The method parameter enforces this as an input, and update operations must have records to update.
oldDataFile is passed as a parameter and used to get the update handle for the merge; cannot be null.
